Question: When the clarifier has several questions that change what gets built, which reading of your words is right?

When non-blocking ones wait too, the first question offers a choice: answer them all now, or a few at a time by principle. Recommended because it matches 'give the option depending on the situation'.); Recommend per question, you choose (Each question shows its options with one recommended, and you always choose; pacing stays as it is (blocking at once, the rest three a turn by principle). Answer: Offer the pacing choice (Recommended)
